headline: Binance reports $3.6 billion in net outflows following cyber theft
summary: Binance detailed US$3.6 billion in net outflows following a major cyber theft incident, which it described as a relatively soft blow to its overall business.
why: Crypto exchange liquidity and net outflows are critical metrics for investors assessing platform solvency and systemic risk in digital asset markets.
why_moved: Substantial capital withdrawals from a major crypto exchange following a security breach raise concerns about liquidity and risk management across digital asset platforms.
